area: display hulls (toybox matrices, the theater's ghosts)
summary: VesselModelBuilder.ResolveDomainMaterials now paints a SkinnedMeshRenderer's slot 0 when a vessel names no domain materials, exactly as the live ship does (ShipHelper.ApplyShipMaterial writes a skinned mesh's materials[0], the fleet's Domain slot). Display hulls used the slot index (1) for every renderer, so a toybox, preview or replay-ghost Goby or Squirrel wore its team colour on the body and the RedAccent placeholder on its accent. TheaterGhost passes the renderer kind; DomainMaterialSlotTests holds the rule.
why: Garrett, 2026-11-10 (LOCKED): every colour comes from the colour set; a team's colour is its owner's domain.
